svg.title: Quality and releases: how the pieces fit — SoftTrack web design mockup (#238)
svg.desc: A bug has exactly the fields a task has, nothing is called a release, and testing leaves no trace. The epic adds details on bugs, releases with a fix version and release notes, test cases linked to stories, and test runs that record results and raise bugs.
svg.text: Quality and releases: how the pieces fit
· bug details, versions and test runs

g.text: A bug is more than a task with a different icon.
Severity, environment, steps to reproduce, and the version it was
A name for a set of tickets.
A fix version on a ticket, a page per release, and release notes
By whom, against what, and with what result.
Steps and what should happen, linked to the stories they cover.
A pass through the cases, for a release or a sprint.

svg.text: What a ticket gains, by type
Fix version: the release it ships in
A team that uses none of it sees none of it: no releases defined means no release field on a ticket.
“Found in” and “fixed in” need a release to point at. A run is a pass through cases.
Principles: a team that uses none of it sees none of it; everything is per team, like statuses, labels and templates; guests read and change nothing. What a single team wants
beyond the built-in bug details belongs to #117. Each piece has its own mockup on its issue, #272 to #275.
